name: agent_review
description: Record the agent's own explanation of one grouped tool issue, or open an issue no failed call produced (a sub-agent that ignored its review prompt, a workflow that wasted calls). Administrator only. One record per group or title: a later call replaces the earlier one
retry_hint: a repeated note for the same group replaces the earlier one, so a retry is harmless

tool.description: The issue group's tool name, exactly as reported

class.description: The issue group's class: error, denied, uncertain or warning

kind.description: The issue group's error kind, exactly as reported

template.description: The issue group's message template, exactly as reported

note.description: What you were trying to do, what you expected, and what would have prevented the issue, written so someone can fix the cause without reading this conversation

action.description: note (default): explain an existing issue group. open: record an issue you observed that no failed call created

title.description: For action open: a short title, at most 200 characters

detail.description: For action open: what happened, what you expected, and what would prevent it

severity.description: For action open: blocker stops work, waste costs calls, noise is cosmetic

evidence.description: For action open: a measured value a reviewer can check, such as 'prompts 3, notes 0' or 'artifacts 2, delivered 0'. Required: a claim without evidence cannot be verified

subject_session_id.description: For action open: the session the issue is about; omit for this session
